[eval r03] Reference note for this evaluation pass: distinct opening tokens, so neither the block cache nor any sibling case's warm prefix can cover this prompt's prefill.

Reproducibility is a discipline before it is a tool. A benchmark number is only evidence if the complete circumstances that produced it can be reconstructed later: the exact binary, identified by build path, revision, and modification time; the exact weights, identified by filename and byte size; the machine shape, described by topology and bench shape; and the configuration switches that were flipped at the time, recorded as a sorted key-value list so that two records can be compared field by field. When a promoted baseline carries that fingerprint, every later verification run can answer the first question a mismatch raises: is this a code regression, or did the world change underneath us? Without the fingerprint the question is unanswerable, and the only honest verdict is suspicion.

The seal itself is deliberately unforgiving. Greedy decoding at temperature zero turns the model into a deterministic function of build, weights, prompt, and topology, so the normalized completion can be hashed and the hash treated as a contract. Any change that alters the floating-point trajectory, however small, can flip an argmax at a near-tie somewhere deep in the completion, and the hash will notice even when a human skimming the text would not. That sensitivity is the feature. The cost of the feature is that legitimate environment changes also break the seal, which is precisely why the fingerprint check exists alongside it: a hash mismatch with a matching fingerprint points the investigation at the code, while matching hashes with a mismatched fingerprint is a provenance warning, yellow rather than red, because the output contract held even though the machine did not match the record.

Long prompts stress a different seam of the same discipline. A short prompt can be served almost entirely from a warm prefix cache, and its prefill timing is then a measurement of cache lookup rather than of compute. A prompt of several hundred tokens, opened with a unique marker so that no cached block applies, forces the server to run the full prefill path: tokenization, embedding, every attention and feed-forward layer over the whole input, and the first sampled token at the end of that chain. Time-to-first-token on such a prompt is the number that actually tracks prefill regressions, and the decode that follows reads the full key-value cache at every step, so decode throughput on a long context tracks attention-path changes that a short context would hide.

The quantization story belongs in the same provenance record as the build. A Q4_0 weight set and a Q8_0 weight set are different models for seal purposes even when they came from the same source checkpoint, because dequantization changes the numeric trajectory token by token. Two builds that agree on the first dozen tokens can diverge completely after the first near-tie, so the seal hashes the entire completion and the fingerprint names the quant that produced it. Comparing a seal across quants is a category error, and the fingerprint makes the category visible.

Scheduling and concurrency round out the environmental picture. Continuous batching means a decode measurement depends on co-resident requests; a neighbor on the same device inflates variance long before it moves the median, and a contaminated iteration poisons the summary no matter how clean the others were. The contamination gate fires on the coefficient of variation for that reason, and the correct response is to quiet the machine and rerun rather than to widen the gate. Peer-to-peer availability, NUMA pinning, memory-locked weights, and flash-attention compilation all belong in the same record, because each one can move the numbers by more than the regression a campaign is hunting for.

These three long prompts close the loop between prose and protocol. They share a subject and deliberately disagree on everything else: distinct marker lines, distinct paragraph orders, distinct bodies, so that within a run and across repetitions every one of them misses the prefix cache and lands on the cold prefill path. Their token counts sit in the same neighborhood so that a comparison between cases measures the build and the cache policy rather than the shape of the filler. When a future run seals green on this suite, the claim being made is narrow and real: this build, on this fingerprinted configuration, reproduces exactly what a human reviewed and promoted.
